# SmartDevBox

> SmartDevBox is a free, AI-powered developer toolbox at https://smartdevbox.com.
> Paste any text — it auto-detects the format and applies the right tool instantly.
> No sign-up required. Works entirely in the browser.

## What SmartDevBox does

SmartDevBox is the fastest way for developers to encode, decode, format, convert,
inspect, and generate data. Paste anything — Base64, JSON, JWT, XML, SQL, a URL,
a Unix timestamp, a certificate, hex bytes, a cron expression — and SmartDevBox
identifies the format and transforms it automatically, powered by AI.

## Tool categories and tools

### Encoding / Decoding (18 tools)
- Base64 Encode / Decode — encode text to Base64 or decode a Base64 string back to text
- URL Encode / Decode — percent-encode strings for URLs or decode them back
- JWT Inspector — decode and inspect a JWT token header and payload without a secret
- JWT Encoder — create a signed JWT token (HS256, HS384, HS512)
- HTML Encode / Decode — encode special characters to HTML entities and back
- Hex ↔ ASCII — convert between hexadecimal and ASCII text
- Backslash Escape / Unescape — escape or unescape backslash sequences
- ROT13 / ROT47 — encode or decode text using ROT13 and ROT47 ciphers
- Base32 Encode / Decode — encode text to Base32 or decode Base32 back to text
- URL Parser — parse a URL into protocol, host, path, query params, and hash
- Base64 Image Decode — decode a Base64 data URI and show image metadata

### Formatting (12 tools)
- JSON Formatter — pretty-print and validate JSON with configurable indentation
- XML Formatter / Minify — pretty-print or minify XML
- SQL Formatter — format and beautify SQL queries
- CSS Beautifier / Minify — format or minify CSS stylesheets
- HTML Beautifier — format and beautify HTML markup
- JS Beautifier / Minifier / Validator — format, minify, or validate JavaScript
- Markdown Preview — live split preview of Markdown source and rendered output
- JSON Validate — validate JSON and report errors with line and column numbers

### Conversion (21 tools)
- JSON ↔ CSV — convert between JSON arrays and CSV
- JSON ↔ TSV — convert between JSON arrays and tab-separated values
- JSON ↔ YAML — convert between JSON and YAML
- JSON ↔ XML — convert between JSON and XML
- CSV → JSON — parse CSV into a JSON array
- HTML → JSX — convert HTML markup to React JSX
- HTML → Text — strip HTML tags and extract plain text
- Markdown → HTML — convert Markdown to HTML
- JSON Escape / Unescape — escape strings for embedding in JSON values
- Color Converter — convert colors between HEX, RGB, HSL, and HSV
- Number Base Converter — convert integers between binary, octal, decimal, and hex
- Unix Timestamp — convert Unix timestamps to human-readable dates and back
- Date Formatter — format dates in multiple locales and styles
- Seconds ↔ H:M:S — convert between seconds and hours:minutes:seconds
- Decimal ↔ Roman — convert between decimal integers and Roman numerals
- UUID ↔ Hex — convert between UUID format and 32-char hex

### Generation (10 tools)
- UUID Generator — generate UUID v4 strings
- ULID Generator — generate Universally Unique Lexicographically Sortable Identifiers
- Hash Generator — compute MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, and SHA-512 hashes
- Random String Generator — generate random strings with configurable charset and length
- Random Password Generator — generate secure random passwords
- Lorem Ipsum Generator — generate placeholder Latin text
- QR Code Generator — generate QR codes from URLs or any text (PNG export)
- Random Number Generator — generate random integers or decimals within a range
- Random IP Generator — generate random IPv4 addresses
- Random MAC Generator — generate random MAC addresses

### Inspection (6 tools)
- Regex Tester — test regular expressions against input text and list all matches
- JSONPath Evaluator — evaluate JSONPath expressions against JSON input
- String Inspector — detailed character, word, line, and byte statistics
- Cron Job Parser — parse and explain cron expressions with next scheduled run times
- Certificate Decoder (X.509) — decode and inspect PEM-encoded X.509 certificates
- HTML Preview — live preview HTML in a sandboxed iframe

### Text (23 tools)
- Case converters: lowercase, UPPERCASE, Title Case, camelCase, PascalCase,
  snake_case, kebab-case, CONSTANT_CASE, Invert Case
- Line tools: Sort lines, Dedupe lines, Reverse lines, Number lines,
  Prefix lines, Suffix lines, Join lines, Remove empty lines
- Text tools: Word Count, Text Reverse, Text Trim
- Extractors: Extract Emails, Extract URLs, Extract Numbers

## Key questions SmartDevBox answers

- How do I decode a Base64 string?
- How do I decode a JWT token without a secret?
- How do I format or validate JSON?
- How do I convert a Unix timestamp to a date?
- How do I convert JSON to CSV?
- How do I generate a UUID?
- How do I compute a SHA-256 hash?
- How do I parse a cron expression?
- How do I decode an X.509 certificate?
- How do I convert between color formats (HEX, RGB, HSL)?
- How do I format a SQL query?
- How do I convert JSON to YAML?

## Technical details

- URL: https://smartdevbox.com
- Free to use, no account required
- Runs entirely in the browser (no data sent to servers except optional AI routing)
- Optional AI mode uses GPT-4o-mini for ambiguous input detection
- Built with Next.js 15, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, deployed on Cloudflare Workers
- 84+ tools across 6 categories
